descriptions.before: An object used to create custom events that scripts can fire and connect to.
descriptions.after: An object which enables custom events through asynchronous one-way communication between scripts on the same side of the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a BindableEvent do not yield.

descriptions.before: Fires the BindableEvent which in turn fires the BindableEvent.Event event.
descriptions.after: Fires the BindableEvent which in turn fires the Event event.

descriptions.before: Values to be passed with the event.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to Event events connected to the same BindableEvent.

descriptions.before: The event that is fired when BindableEvent:Fire() is called.
descriptions.after: Fires when any script calls the Fire() method on the same BindableEvent instance.

descriptions.before: An object used to expose a function to other scripts.
descriptions.after: An object which allows for synchronous two-way communication between scripts on the same side of the client-server boundary. Scripts invoking a BindableFunction yield until the corresponding callback is found.

descriptions.before: Calls the BindableFunction.OnInvoke callback of the BindableFunction, returning any values returned by the callback.
descriptions.after: Invokes the BindableFunction which in turn calls the OnInvoke callback, returning any values returned by the callback.

descriptions.before: Values to be passed to the callback.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to the OnInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Values passed to the callback.
descriptions.after: Values returned from the OnInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Callback for when the BindableFunction is invoked with BindableFunction:Invoke().
descriptions.after: Callback for when the BindableFunction is invoked with Invoke().

descriptions.before: The parameters sent when the BindableFunction is invoked.
descriptions.after: The parameters sent through Invoke().
Values returned by the callback function.
Determines how the constraint force will be limited. Only used if RigidityEnabled is false.
Determines the axes that the constraint uses to limit the force. Only applies when RigidityEnabled is false and AlignPosition.ForceLimitMode is PerAxis.
Maximum force along each axis that the constraint can apply to achieve its goal.

descriptions.before: Maximum force the constraint can apply to achieve its goal.
descriptions.after: Maximum force magnitude the constraint can apply to achieve its goal.

descriptions.before: Item expiration, in seconds. The item is automatically removed from the sorted map once the expiration duration is reached. The maximum expiration time is 30 days (2,592,000 seconds).
descriptions.after: Item expiration, in seconds. The item is automatically removed from the sorted map once the expiration duration is reached. The maximum expiration time is 45 days (3,888,000 seconds).

descriptions.before: Similar to BindableEvent, but allows crossing the client/server boundary.
descriptions.after: An object which facilitates asynchronous, one-way communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts firing a RemoteEvent do not yield.

descriptions.before: Fires the RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent event for each client.
descriptions.after: Fires the OnClientEvent event for each client connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: The arguments that will be passed to all RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent methods.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to all OnClientEvent events connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: Fires RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent for the specified player.
descriptions.after: Fires the OnClientEvent event for a specific client connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: The Player that the remote event is being fired to.
descriptions.after: The client of the Player to fire the event to.

descriptions.before: The arguments passed to the RemoteEvent.OnClientEvent method.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to OnClientEvent events connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: Fires the RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent event on the server using the arguments specified with an additional player argument at the beginning.
descriptions.after: Fires the OnServerEvent event on the server from one client connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: The arguments passed to the RemoteEvent.OnServerEvent method.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to OnServerEvent events connected to the same RemoteEvent.

descriptions.before: Fires listening functions in LocalScript when either RemoteEvent:FireClient() or RemoteEvent:FireAllClients() is called from a Script.
descriptions.after: Fires from a LocalScript when either FireClient() or FireAllClients() is called on the same RemoteEvent instance from a Script.

descriptions.before: Fires listening functions in Script when RemoteEvent:FireServer() is called from a LocalScript.
descriptions.after: Fires from a Script when FireServer() is called on the same RemoteEvent instance from a LocalScript.

descriptions.before: Used to create in-game APIs that both the client and the server can use to communicate with each other.
descriptions.after: An object which facilitates synchronous, two-way communication across the client-server boundary. Scripts invoking a RemoteFunction yield until they receive a response from the recipient.

descriptions.before: Calls the function bound to the RemoteFunction by RemoteFunction.OnClientInvoke for the given Player. Use only in a Script.
descriptions.after: Invokes the RemoteFunction which in turn calls the OnClientInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: The Player that the remote function is being fired to.
descriptions.after: The Player associated with the client to invoke.

descriptions.before: The arguments passed to the RemoteEvent.OnClientInvoke method.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to the OnClientInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Values returned by RemoteFunction.OnClientInvoke.
descriptions.after: Values returned from the OnClientInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Calls the function bound to the RemoteFunction by RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke and returns what that function returns. Use only in a LocalScript.
descriptions.after: Invokes the RemoteFunction which in turn calls the OnServerInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: The arguments passed to the RemoteEvent.OnServerInvoke method.
descriptions.after: Values to pass to the OnServerInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Values returned by RemoteFunction.OnServerInvoke.
descriptions.after: Values returned from the OnServerInvoke callback.

descriptions.before: Called when the client is invoked by RemoteFunction:InvokeClient().
descriptions.after: Callback for when the RemoteFunction is invoked with InvokeClient().

descriptions.before: Correspond with the arguments passed by RemoteFunction:InvokeClient().
descriptions.after: The parameters sent through InvokeClient().

descriptions.before: Values returned by the function are returned by RemoteFunction:InvokeClient() (back to the server).
descriptions.after: Values returned by the callback function.

descriptions.before: Called when the server is invoked by RemoteFunction:InvokeServer().
descriptions.after: Callback for when the RemoteFunction is invoked with InvokeServer().

descriptions.before: The Player corresponding to the client where the RemoteFunction:InvokeServer() function call originated from.
descriptions.after: The Player associated with the client that the InvokeServer() call originates from.

descriptions.before: Arguments passed to RemoteFunction:InvokeServer() are passed to the function.
descriptions.after: The parameters sent through InvokeServer().

descriptions.before: Values returned by the function are returned by RemoteFunction:InvokeServer() (back to the client).
descriptions.after: Values returned by the callback function.
A single number is used to specify the magnitude of the maximum constraint force. The constraint will ensure that the force it applies will have a magnitude that is less than this limit.

A vector is used to specify the maximum force value along each axis of a given reference frame. The constraint will ensure that each component of the force will have an absolute value that's less than the corresponding vector entry.
